name: ATP binding cassette subfamily C member 10

function.text: ABCC10 is the approved symbol for ATP binding cassette subfamily C member 10. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in ABC-type glutathione S-conjugate transporter activity; ABC-type transporter activity; leukotriene metabolic process.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Breast carcinoma; Glioblastoma; Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.
